summary: One-line default change of SECURE_REFERRER_POLICY from None to 'same-origin' correctly implements the issue's security hardening; SecurityMiddleware already reads this setting so the header takes effect with no further code needed. This is a deliberate, documented secure-default change appropriate for a major release.

issues.description: Changing the default sends Referrer-Policy: same-origin on all responses, which can break third-party sites relying on the Referer header for verification. This is a known, accepted backward-compat tradeoff noted in the issue and warrants a release-notes/backwards-incompatible-changes entry (docs not shown in diff).

Such a security default change normally needs accompanying documentation updates (settings.txt default value, security release notes). Not shown in the source-only diff, so likely handled separately, but worth confirming before merge.
